sentences.text: The fifth season of the fantasy drama television series Game of Thrones premiered on HBO on April 12 , and concluded on June 14 , 2015 .	HBO	HBO	fantasy	fantasy	drama	television drama	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones
It was broadcast on Sunday at 9:00 pm in the United States , consisting of 10 episodes , each running approximately 50 -- 60 minutes .

The season primarily adapts material from A Feast for Crows and A Dance with Dragons , the fourth and fifth novels in George R. R. Martin 's A Song of Ice and Fire series , though it also uses elements from the third novel , A Storm of Swords , as well as the upcoming sixth novel The Winds of Winter .	A Feast for Crows	A Feast for Crows	A Dance with Dragons	A Dance with Dragons	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Storm of Swords	A Storm of Swords	The Winds of Winter	The Winds of Winter
It also contains original content not found in Martin 's novels .
The series is adapted for television by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss .	David Benioff	David Benioff	D. B. Weiss	D. B. Weiss
HBO ordered the fifth season on April 8 , 2014 , together with the sixth season , which began filming in July 2014 .	HBO	HBO	sixth season	Game of Thrones (season 6)
The season was filmed primarily in Ireland , Northern Ireland , Croatia and Spain .

Game of Thrones features a large ensemble cast , including Peter Dinklage , Nikolaj Coster-Waldau , Lena Headey , Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	ensemble cast	ensemble cast	Peter Dinklage	Peter Dinklage	Nikolaj Coster-Waldau	Nikolaj Coster-Waldau	Lena Headey	Lena Headey	Emilia Clarke	Emilia Clarke	Kit Harington	Kit Harington
The season introduced a number of new cast members , including Jonathan Pryce and Alexander Siddig .	Jonathan Pryce	Jonathan Pryce	Alexander Siddig	Alexander Siddig
Critics praised the show 's production values and cast , with specific accolades for Dinklage 's portrayal of Tyrion Lannister .	Tyrion Lannister	Tyrion Lannister
Viewership yet again rose compared to the previous season .

This season set a Guinness World Records for winning the highest number of Emmy Awards for a series in a single season and year , winning 12 out of 24 nominations , including Outstanding Drama Series .
